Name: HIV with dynamics
Description: Framework for an HIV model with vital dynamics and new infections

Name: Use this file to specify the structure of your model. Any extra sheets will be ignored, so you can include other information in them
Databook Pages
Description: Specify which worksheets will be present in the databook

Name: Compartments
Description: Specify the states that an individual can be in - an individual is only ever in one compartment at a time

Name: Transitions
Description: Specify which transitions between compartments are possible

Name: Characteristics
Description: Specify groups of people (e.g. groups of compartments) for data entry

Name: Parameters
Description: Define how to compute the flows between compartments

Name: Cascades
Description: Use the Cascades sheet to define the cascade if it is more complex than just all characteristics in sequence
